tasks.title: Add the new context-switcher/refusal/no-context locale keys and the two new icons
tasks.dod: en/common.json, uk/common.json, en/workspace.json and uk/workspace.json gain matching keys for the grouped-switcher trigger label, the Workspace row label and its unnamed-Workspace placeholder, the two group labels, the current/archived/no-access trailing labels and the inert-row explanation, both refusal states, the no-context state, the landing pending and error states, and the Enter action; the three retained workspaceSwitcher.* message keys are left untouched with their existing copy; LogInIcon and LayoutGridIcon are added to shared/icons following the existing wrapper pattern and exported from shared/icons/index.ts; the existing localization parity test asserts identical key sets across en and uk for all 8 namespaces and the icons spec covers both new icons.

tasks.title: Build the WarehouseEntryRefusal component with both refusal reasons
tasks.dod: shared/components/WarehouseEntryRefusal.tsx renders a page-level state block (icon + heading + body in a left-aligned 560px column, per design-handoff.md's State Block mapping) selected by a reason prop of 'not-a-member' | 'archived'; component unit tests assert the not-a-member copy names no Warehouse, id, existence, Role, member or record and is byte-identical whatever the id, that the archived copy names the archived state and nothing further, that neither branch renders any Warehouse content or navigation list, and that both point at the context switcher as the way out.

tasks.title: Implement the resolveWarehouseEntry entry-verdict guard
tasks.dod: guards/warehouse-entry.guard.ts exports resolveWarehouseEntry(context, warehouseId) as a plain function with no React import that dispatches getWorkspaceContext through the store with subscribe:false and returns { status: 'entered' | 'refused', reason?: 'not-a-member' | 'archived', warehouseId }; guard unit tests assert an identical 'not-a-member' verdict for a non-existent id, a foreign-Workspace id, an own-Workspace id the actor holds no membership in and a malformed id, that no shape validation runs before the membership lookup, that a membership in an archived Warehouse yields 'archived', that a live membership yields 'entered', and that the function never throws a redirect.

tasks.title: Establish the Warehouse layout route, its dashboard child and useEnteredWarehouse
tasks.dod: shared/constants/routes.ts gains WAREHOUSE and WAREHOUSE_ACCESS plus a ROUTE_SEGMENTS sibling for relative child segments (ACCESS still declared, removed by T6); routes/warehouse.route.tsx declares the layout route running requireAuth then resolveWarehouseEntry and returning the verdict into the match context; shared/layouts/WarehouseLayout.tsx renders Outlet for 'entered' and WarehouseEntryRefusal otherwise; shared/hooks/useEnteredWarehouse.ts reads that match non-throwing and returns the id only for 'entered'; modules/warehouse/{route,page}.tsx renders DesignSystemExample moved unchanged from modules/home/components; routes/catch-all.route.tsx declares the Warehouse-level splat child; router.ts registers the layout with its dashboard, splat children; modules/home/page.tsx renders the no-context state block; route-integration tests pin the three TanStack Router v1 behaviors the design rests on (a parent beforeLoad return value reaching the match context, beforeLoad not re-running while navigating between the layout's children, and the $ splat ranking below explicit children) and assert that /warehouses/X and any address beneath it render the refusal in place at the requested address with no redirect and no access-projection request.

tasks.title: Build the RouteErrorState component with a retry that re-runs the failed load
tasks.dod: shared/components/RouteErrorState.tsx renders the application's standard route error state — triangle-alert in $danger, heading, body, and a primary Try again control that re-runs the failed load — and component unit tests assert the retry invokes the router's reset/invalidate path and that the component is distinct from the no-context state.

tasks.title: Move the access surface under the Warehouse layout and read the Warehouse from the address
tasks.dod: modules/access/route.tsx becomes a child of warehouseRoute at ROUTE_SEGMENTS.ACCESS with no beforeLoad of its own; ROUTES.ACCESS is deleted and every reference to it updated in the same change; useCurrentPermissions reads useEnteredWarehouse() instead of context.effectiveWarehouseId, yielding permissionIds [] and skipping the projection query outside a Warehouse view; usePermissions unit tests assert the projection is requested for the addressed Warehouse and that changing the stored selection changes nothing about an open address; a route-integration test asserts /warehouses/W1/access and /warehouses/W2/access each show their own named Warehouse's Roles, Permission catalogue and members, and that a member of W whose Role carries neither ROLES:WATCH nor USERS:WATCH is admitted to the address and sees the existing unpopulated access state rather than a refusal or a redirect.

tasks.title: Implement the landing resolver on / and the root not-found redirect
tasks.dod: guards/landing.guard.ts exports resolveLandingContext evaluating CR-AC-08's three rules in order and throwing at most one redirect; modules/home/route.tsx runs requireAuth then resolveLandingContext and carries RouteErrorState as its errorComponent; routes/catch-all.route.tsx gains the root splat redirecting to ROUTES.HOME; guard unit tests assert rule (1) fires for an actor holding any one of the four administration Permissions, rule (2) consumes effectiveWarehouseId unchanged with no membership-picking logic, and several live memberships with no valid stored selection reaches rule (3); route-integration tests assert exactly one navigation resolves landing, that no rule is evaluated while the context read is unresolved, that a failed read renders RouteErrorState and not the no-context state, that a registrant holding Workspace Owner lands in /workspace, and that no actor is redirected twice between / and /workspace.

tasks.title: Record the entered Warehouse as the stored selection without blocking entry
tasks.dod: modules/warehouse/hooks/useRecordWarehouseEntry.ts compares the entered Warehouse against effectiveWarehouseId and dispatches setActiveWarehouse only when they differ, fire-and-forget after render and awaited by no route, guard or gate; WarehouseLayout mounts it only in the entered branch; store/middleware/api-error.middleware.ts gains a named silent-failure allowlist whose only member is setActiveWarehouse; hook unit tests assert no write on refresh or re-entry of the Warehouse the effective value already names, a write on entry to a different Warehouse, and that a rejected write leaves the Warehouse view rendered with its membership capabilities intact and raises no alert; a middleware unit test asserts every other rejected endpoint still alerts.

tasks.title: Replace the flat switcher with the grouped context switcher
tasks.dod: shared/layouts/WarehouseSwitcher.tsx renders one grouped control at all times — a single Workspace row labelled with the Workspace name or its unnamed placeholder above a labelled, nested group of the actor's Warehouses — where both levels are destinations that navigate on selection and never mutate; the Workspace row is inert (not a link, not activatable by pointer or keyboard, conveyed as disabled, carrying its one-line explanation and nothing beyond the Workspace name) exactly when hasWorkspacePermission(workspacePermissionIds, workspaceAdministrationPermissionIds) is false; archived rows stay listed, dimmed, labelled Archived and unselectable; current-row marking comes from useEnteredWarehouse() and the /workspace match via a check indicator plus the word Current, never colour alone, with no row marked at the root or around a refusal; the three retained messages render beside the control with their existing copy and only when no context is entered; component unit tests cover every state above plus that no credential is requested on selection and that group labels are non-focusable section headers.

tasks.title: Make the sidebar context-selected
tasks.dod: shared/layouts/Sidebar.tsx selects its list from the entered context — in a Warehouse view Dashboard and Access, both addressed within that :warehouseId with Access still gated by the unchanged ROLES_WATCH ∪ USERS_WATCH PermissionGate; in the Workspace view the Workspace administration entry only; in no context no list and no <nav> landmark at all — with no entry from one level appearing in the other; component unit tests assert each list, that no Warehouse-view entry survives into the Workspace view or vice versa, that around a refusal no list renders, and that during a W1→W2 switch the Access entry is absent while W2's projection is unresolved and then appears, with no skeleton, placeholder or held-over W1 value.

tasks.title: Wire the shell chrome to the entered context without changing anything else in it
tasks.dod: shared/layouts/RootLayout.tsx renders the narrow-viewport drawer toggle only when the sidebar has a list to show, so no context can open an empty drawer, and keeps rendering the grouped switcher in the same two places (header at/above sm, context bar below sm); component unit tests assert the toggle is absent in the no-context state and around a refusal, present in both entered contexts, and that the brand link, language selector, sign-out control, footer, the 240px persistent sidebar container, the drawer's focus trap and focus return, and the auth-route and chrome-less branches all render and behave exactly as before.

tasks.title: Add the Enter action to the Workspace warehouses tab
tasks.dod: WarehousesTab passes the actor's own membership ids from the GET /workspace/context read it already performs down to WarehouseList as one prop; WarehouseList's row becomes a container holding the existing selection button plus, only for a non-archived Warehouse present in that membership list, a trailing Enter link to ROUTES.WAREHOUSE — never nested inside the selection button — with every other row rendering no Enter control at all; component unit tests assert Enter is present for a non-archived membership row, absent (not disabled) for a non-membership row, an archived membership row and an archived non-membership row, that rename, archive/restore and grant/withdraw remain unchanged on every row, and that row focus order places the selection button before Enter.

tasks.title: Enforce the effectiveWarehouseId allowlist with an architecture check
tasks.dod: apps/web/eslint.config.mjs restricts any effectiveWarehouseId reference in the non-test sources of apps/web/src to an explicit three-file allowlist — the landing resolver, the switcher and the entry write — and pnpm --filter @warehouser/web lint passes on the change while failing on a deliberately added fourth reference, verified once and reverted.

tasks.title: Cover entry, refusal, landing, not-found and no-eviction end to end
tasks.dod: router.spec.tsx and the shared fixtures cover, through createAppRouter({ appStore, initialEntries }): two independent memory routers holding two different Warehouse addresses in one session neither of which re-points the other; a non-member address and any address beneath it rendering the non-disclosing refusal at the requested address with no stored-selection write, no access-projection request and no sidebar; an archived membership address rendering the archived refusal; unmatched addresses including a bookmarked /access landing at / and resolving, with an unauthenticated actor still reaching sign-in; a Workspace-context refetch that archives W or withdraws the membership while the actor is inside W leaving them in W's view at the same address; a member of W without ROLES:WATCH/USERS:WATCH admitted to W's access address; and every Warehouse-scoped request still naming its Warehouse explicitly through warehousePath.

tasks.title: Verify the 390px switcher fit and the entry-latency ceiling manually
tasks.dod: A recorded manual run confirms at a 390px viewport that the grouped switcher with its Workspace row and nested group fits the existing context bar without horizontal overflow and its popover does not overflow the viewport, that the restructured warehouses-tab row and the no-context shell render without a drawer toggle, and that five consecutive runs from activating a switcher row and from activating an Enter action to the Warehouse view being rendered with its own access projection resolved each complete within 250 ms measured by client-side navigation timing, with the five figures written into the task record.
